steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Power chords (root + fifth, no third) create a raw, powerful sound — they are ambiguous between major and minor, giving rock its aggressive character. | Key Fact: Drum kit in rock: kick drum (beats 1 and 3), snare (beats 2 and 4 = backbeat), hi-hat (subdivides the beat), crash cymbal (accents). | Key Fact: Studio production became a creative tool: automatic double-tracking (ADT) thickens vocal sound; reverb creates spatial depth; distortion adds harmonic richness. | Key Fact: Progressive rock expanded rock's structural scope: longer forms, classical influences, concept albums, complex time signatures and technical virtuosity.
